answer: Attacker cost becomes real: forging N agents requires N stakes plus sustained honest work to climb from the oasis of zero-history accounts, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be anchored in a staked identity vault where each agent locks collateral prior to voting; a prism contract then splits reputation across distinct epochs so freshly minted identities start empty. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
